cases.translation: On that day I will strike Egypt.
cases.explain: Temporal expression с в (in/on) takes accusative case.

cases.translation: I will give it into the hand of an enemy.
cases.explain: The phrase в руку (into the hand of) with possession takes genitive case.

cases.translation: I will destroy the idols in Memphis.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location requires prepositional case.

cases.translation: There will be no more a prince in the land of Egypt.
cases.explain: Правитель as the subject of будет requires nominative case.

cases.translation: I will set fire to Zoan and execute judgments on Thebes.
cases.explain: The transitive verb покараю requires accusative case for its object.

cases.translation: I will pour my wrath upon Sin.
cases.explain: The transitive verb залью requires accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: The enemy will make an assault on Memphis.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on/against) with direction requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: Юноши Гелиополя и Бубаста падут от ___.
cases.translation: The young men of Aven and of Bubastis will fall by the sword.
cases.explain: The preposition от (by/from) governs genitive case.

reading.ru: Я уничтожу идолов и истреблю истуканы в Мемфисе.
reading.question: What will God destroy in Memphis?
reading.explain: God explicitly states He will destroy idols and eliminate images in Memphis.

reading.ru: В Египте больше не будет правителя.
reading.question: What will be the political consequence of God's judgment?
options: There will be no more a prince in Egypt
The people will choose their own leader
reading.correct: There will be no more a prince in Egypt
reading.explain: The text directly states that there will no longer be a ruler in Egypt.

reading.ru: Я наведу на Египет страх, я придам разорению Патрос, подожгу Цоан и покараю Фивы.
reading.question: What series of judgments will come upon Egypt's cities?
options: Fear, destruction of Pathros, fire on Zoan, and judgment on Thebes
reading.correct: Fear, destruction of Pathros, fire on Zoan, and judgment on Thebes
reading.explain: God describes a cascade of judgments: fear, desolation, fire, and punishment across multiple Egyptian cities.

reading.ru: Ярость свою залью на Нос, египетскую крепость, и погублю фиванские орды.
reading.question: What will God do to Sin and Thebes?
options: Pour His wrath on Sin (the fortress) and destroy the multitude of Thebes
reading.correct: Pour His wrath on Sin (the fortress) and destroy the multitude of Thebes
reading.explain: God will pour His wrath on Sin fortress and cut off the multitude of Thebes.

reading.ru: Юноши Гелиополя и Бубаста падут от меча, и горожане отправятся в плен.
reading.question: What will happen to the young men and people of Egypt's cities?
options: Young men will fall by the sword, and citizens will go into captivity
reading.correct: Young men will fall by the sword, and citizens will go into captivity
reading.explain: The passage describes both military defeat (young men falling) and exile (people taken captive).

reading.ru: Я покараю Египет, и тогда узнают, что я Господь.
reading.question: What will be proven by God's judgment on Egypt?
options: That Egypt is the greatest power
reading.explain: Through His judgment on Egypt, God will make it clear to all that He is the Lord.
